FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions from the captured CMA FAQ page, with first-class guidance and class-level requirements.

Do i need to register for a class before attending?

Before your first class, call us at (415) 359-9294 or email hello@cmasf.com so we can direct you to the right class based on your skill level.

What do i need for my first class?

Wear comfortable athletic clothing and contact CMA before your first visit so the team can direct you to the right class.

How much experience do i need for intermediate, advanced and sparring classes?

A beginner class is required first. Intermediate, advanced drilling, and sparring require coach permission.

do i need my own equipment for class?

Intermediate class requires gloves and shin guards. Contact the gym if you need help preparing for your first class.

how much physical contact is involved?

Class contact depends on level and coach approval. There is no unsupervised sparring without coach approval.

Do you offer private one-on-one sessions?

Yes. Individual coach pages include a private coaching request form.

Try a Class

Contact us to try a class!

No pre-registration is required, but first-timers should contact CMA so the team can recommend the right beginner class.
